rules.when: The request is an extremely small, bounded, fully specified change such as a config value, rename, or similarly small fix; it is off the critical path and end-to-end latency does not matter.
rules.why: Kun says Luna is cheap but slow in turns, so reserve it for background work and keep Sonnet as fallback (x.com/kunchenguid/status/2103325882752598078; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2102787931178176588).

rules.when: The request is a documentation or internal tooling change with a clear description and bounded outcome.
rules.why: Kun's bucket guidance routes routine, bounded work economically, with Luna for background tasks and Sonnet as fallback (x.com/kunchenguid/status/2103277022235766963; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2102787931178176588).

rules.when: The request is to implement a defined feature or slice from a written spec or contract, especially on the critical path where end-to-end speed matters.
rules.why: Kun recommends routing per task and using Sonnet for implementation, while GPT 6.1 Sol is the current Codex workhorse (x.com/kunchenguid/status/2103895901140042044; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2104749177456722354; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2104998134279762141).

rules.when: The request is taste-heavy visual or UX polish of an existing design, with the core product direction already established.
rules.why: Kun assigns design and taste work to Sonnet, with GPT 6.1 Sol as the alternate task-specific route (x.com/kunchenguid/status/2103895901140042044; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2104749177456722354; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2104998134279762141).

rules.when: The request is to plan a feature, write a contract or spec for an unsettled slice, or investigate a complex or not yet understood problem.
rules.why: Kun reserves Opus for planning and unsettled problems, sets effort as a ceiling, and names GPT 6.1 Sol as the alternate frontier route (x.com/kunchenguid/status/2104749177456722354; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2103325882752598078; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2104998134279762141).

rules.when: The request is bounded, checkable research such as verifying a licence or source, or looking up a dataset, with a concrete question and verifiable result.
rules.why: Kun recommends assigning each task to its fitting bucket and GPT 6.1 Sol is the current Codex choice, with Opus as the alternate (x.com/kunchenguid/status/2103277022235766963; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2103895901140042044; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2104998134279762141).

rules.when: The request is an adversarial review of an existing change, looking for defects, unsafe assumptions, or missed edge cases.
rules.why: Kun identifies Sol as his strongest adversarial reviewer and recommends Opus as the alternate when Sol is unavailable (x.com/kunchenguid/status/2103277022235766963; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2104998134279762141).

rules.when: The request is unusually ambiguous or creative and needs premium judgment, or an escalation to resolve a serious disagreement, spiraling review, or unexpectedly large change.
rules.why: Kun reserves this bucket for premium judgment and escalation, while keeping Opus and GPT 6.1 Sol ahead of Fable and Astra and avoiding ultrafast mode (x.com/kunchenguid/status/2103277022235766963; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2105037902224785454; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2104998134279762141).

why: The default is a defined implementation: Kun recommends Sonnet for implementation and GPT 6.1 Sol as a task-specific workhorse, with Opus as the remaining fallback (x.com/kunchenguid/status/2104749177456722354; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2103895901140042044; x.com/kunchenguid/status/2104998134279762141).
